playlist.playlist_description: Dallas’s knowledge of philosophy and theology, along with his background in psychology and science (his first B.A. was in Psychology and his Ph.D. work included a Minor in the History of Science), were a potent combination that prompted invitations to teach around the world in diverse areas, Christian and “secular,” with a unique perspective and gentle authority. Dallas explained that the intersection between his philosophical and Christian teachings could be found in the simple question: Who are you becoming?
